periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt toward the medial axis of the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ellipsoidal/teardrop morphology with a higher vertical than horizontal dimension.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior boundary, creating a vertical elongation below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped profile along the posterior margin across the shoulders.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness, covering approximately 25-30% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap between pinnae, approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the top boundaries.
